notes.sortnums: In-place qsort of vars[] numeric slots; caller must ensure valid array range.
notes.sortstrs: In-place qsort of vars[] string pointers; source underflow check prints but does not return (potential safety concern).
notes.twalk: Prints tree nodes via twalk callback; consumes root index.
notes._lnext: Private; returns next linked-list node pointer or null.
notes.import: Imports a named file; library search path applies.
notes.freadline: getline-managed line buffer; pointer lifetime and EOF behavior need further testing.
notes.freadall: Allocates via custom allocator; returns buffer and byte length.
notes.redirect: Changes interpreter output FILE*; preserve valid stream lifetime.
notes.fork: Creates child process; do not exercise in routine test harness.
notes.exit: Terminates interpreter process; use subprocess-only testing.

notes.times: Runtime loop setup. Known behavior: zero/negative count still executes body once; compiled-word context required.
notes.again: Runtime loop back-edge; requires active times loop.
notes.exittimes: Exit active times loop; does not restore arbitrary stack state.
notes.for: Runtime loop setup: pops step, start, limit; zero step can produce nonterminating loop.
notes.i: Topmost loop counter; requires active loop.
notes.j: Second most recent loop counter; requires at least two active loops.
notes.k: Third most recent loop counter; requires at least three active loops.
notes.if: COMPILE-TIME conditional syntax: rewrites instruction into OP_JUMPZ; the flag is consumed at runtime by generated jump, not by OP_IF itself.
notes.else: COMPILE-TIME syntax: patches previous conditional jump; not a runtime data-stack operation.
notes.endif: COMPILE-TIME syntax: patches pending jump; not a runtime data-stack operation.
notes.return: Runtime return from compiled word; restores instruction pointer and local-variable base.
notes._regcomp: Allocates compiled regex with custom allocator; compilation failure pushes -1; regex flags follow POSIX regcomp.
notes._regexec: Allocates 10 match slots on each call; returns -1 on no match; allocation lifecycle needs review.
notes._regread: Returns rm_so and rm_eo; match-index bounds are not checked in opcode.
notes._sqlite_open: On sqlite3_open failure prints diagnostic and returns without pushing a result.
notes._sqlite_prepare: On prepare failure prints diagnostic and returns without pushing a result.
notes._sqlite_step: Pushes SQLITE_ROW or SQLITE_DONE on success; error branch returns without pushing.
notes._sqlite_column: Returns sqlite3_column_text pointer; assumes non-NULL text and calls strlen, unsafe for SQL NULL; pointer owned by SQLite.
notes._sqlite_finalize: Consumes statement; error branch calls sqlite3_db_handle on finalized statement, potentially unsafe.
notes._sqlite_exec: Executes SQL with callback; prints errors but does not push status.
notes._sqlite_close: Consumes database pointer; prints errors but does not push status.
notes._pm_list: Prints PortMidi devices to stderr; no stack effect.
notes._pm_open_out: Opens selected MIDI output; return status not checked.
notes._pm_ws: Writes short MIDI message with PortMidi timestamp; status,data1,data2 pop order.
notes._pm_wsr: Writes short MIDI message timestamp 0; NOTE reverse argument order vs _pm_ws.
notes._pm_open_in: Opens MIDI input; sets active/sysex filter; errors printed to stderr.
notes._pm_read: If event available returns data2,data1,status; otherwise returns -1,-1,event_status (0 or negative).
notes._pm_close: Closes open MIDI streams; prints confirmation.
notes._osc_put_str: Writes NUL-terminated OSC string padded to 4 bytes; updates offset. No destination-capacity check.
notes._osc_put_i32: Writes network-byte-order 32-bit integer; no destination-capacity check.
notes._osc_put_f32: Casts to 32-bit float and writes network-byte-order bits; no destination-capacity check.
